definitions: An argument or objection based on an ambiguity of wording or similar trivial circumstance; a minor complaint. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
To complain or argue in a trivial or petty manner.
To contest, especially some trivial issue in a petty manner.

blocks.text: In fiction, a quibble is a plot device used to fulfill the exact verbal conditions of an agreement in order to avoid the intended meaning. Typically quibbles are used in legal bargains and, in fantasy, magically enforced ones such as prophecies. They may be ways to evade the injustice of the rash promise or unjustly evade consequences.

images.alt: The Snaptun stone has been identified as Loki with his lips stitched shut after using a quibble to save his head
